given: a stock record whose batch_number and serial_number are NULL because its legacy code did not parse
when: an operator views that record in the stock detail or list view
then: the batch and serial fields render a clear empty state rather than an error or a broken layout, and the rest of the record still displays

independence.rationale: Distinct from AC1/AC2, which cover the populated case: this asserts the observable behavior for a record with NULL batch/serial (a nonconforming backfilled row). The populated-value views can work while the NULL case errors or shows a blank/garbled cell, and vice versa, so it is separately breakable.
